categories.label: Other

comment: The one shared food taxonomy for PitTech publishing and Discover (owner decision, 2026-10-27). Categories are a controlled list, never free text: a publication carries exactly one category id, the publication contract validates it as an enum, and both apps render labels and examples from this file for the publish picker and the Discover filter. Display order is alphabetical with Other pinned last as the escape hatch. Publications written before the taxonomy existed carry no category and are treated as Other everywhere.
